Support Babel 8 (#22)

Babel 8 is ESM-only and requires node ^22.18.0 || >=24.11.0, which broke
the per-package Dependabot bumps (CJS require of ESM in the build step,
ERR_REQUIRE_ESM for node -r @babel/register, and old node in CI).

Instead of chasing the toolchain, drop it:

- Write src/index.js as plain CommonJS and publish it directly; remove
  the @babel/cli build step, @babel/register, @babel/preset-env,
  @babel/node, npm-run-all and .babelrc. A .default interop property
  keeps require(...).default working as the old compiled lib did.
- Run specs as native ESM (.mjs) with plain node.
- Test against Babel 6, 7 and 8 at once: @babel/core@^8 plus a babel7
  npm alias (npm:@babel/core@^7) plus babel-core@6.
- CI: node 22.x/24.x, checkout@v4,
